title: CLARKSONS HELLAS - SnP WEEKLY
summary:
Main
On the geopolitical front, Hormuz remains the main flashpoint. Tanker attacks continue almost daily,with Iran claiming more vessels hit mines this week, while US-Iran talks to reopen the strait have stalled, keeping shipping exposed to further disruption. Separately, Trump, Putin and Xi agreed at their first three-way summit in Shenzhen on 19 November to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products.
